notes_for_editor: Station record merges three lights (1860 bluff light, 1889 pierhead, 1935 breakwater tower); story focuses on the pier and breakwater lights. Sources disagree on height (Bulletin 78 ft; NRHP 16 ft base + 40/46/47 ft superstructure; 78 ft is the focal plane per NRHP), base size (LHF 20 ft square, NRHP 26), cost ($35,000 NRHP, ~$38,000 LHF), automation year (1975/1976), Almquist's tenure (1942/1946) and 1924 change (electrified vs acetylene+flashing). NRHP says the 1935 light was unmanned yet USLHS lists keepers to 1970 (likely shore-based Coast Guard crew). Pilot quotes are second-hand via NRHP. 1888 Lighthouse Board quote is second-hand via LighthouseFriends (1888 report not in corpus). Newspaper search timed out. LHF quotes use the cached mojibake apostrophe. Whether the breakwater walkway reopened after 2025 is not confirmed.
